title: OpenShift & operator lifecycle (OpenTelemetry)
description: Red Hat product lifecycle for each cluster's OpenShift version and installed operators: support phase, end dates, and OpenShift compatibility. Fed by ocp-lifecycle-exporter.

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source
list.description: Any Prometheus-compatible source holding the ocp_lifecycle_* series.

panels.title: Clusters reporting
panels.description: Clusters with a running lifecycle exporter.

panels.title: Operators: action required
panels.description: Installed operator versions that are end of life or do not support the cluster's current OpenShift version.

panels.title: Operators: plan an update
panels.description: Installed operator versions that block the update channel's target OpenShift version, or whose support ends soon.

panels.title: Operators: OK
panels.description: Supported, and compatible with both the current and target OpenShift version.

panels.title: Not tracked by Red Hat
panels.description: Community/certified operators with no Red Hat lifecycle entry, or a version the lifecycle data does not list.

panels.title: Clusters
panels.description: Each cluster's OpenShift version, the minor its update channel targets, and where that minor is in the Red Hat lifecycle.

targets.expr: max by (k8s_cluster_name, version, ocp_version, channel, target_ocp_version) (ocp_lifecycle_cluster_info{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster"})

panels.title: Operators
panels.description: Every OLM Subscription joined against the Red Hat lifecycle. Sorted worst first. "For current OCP" / "For target OCP" are the newest supported operator versions compatible with the cluster's current minor and with its update channel's target.

targets.expr: max by (k8s_cluster_name, operator_namespace, package, product, installed_version, lifecycle_version, channel, phase, compatible_ocp_versions, link) (ocp_lifecycle_operator_info{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster"})
max by (k8s_cluster_name, operator_namespace, package, status, reasons) (ocp_lifecycle_operator_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster"})
max by (k8s_cluster_name, operator_namespace, package, recommended_version) (ocp_lifecycle_operator_recommended_version_info{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", for="current"})

max by (k8s_cluster_name, operator_namespace, package, target_version) (label_replace(ocp_lifecycle_operator_recommended_version_info{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", for="target"}, "target_version", "$1", "recommended_version", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Operator support remaining (soonest first)
panels.description: Days until standard support ends for each installed operator version. Negative means already past.

panels.title: OpenShift: days left in current phase
panels.description: Days until each cluster's OpenShift minor leaves its current support phase.

panels.title: Operator × OpenShift compatibility – $cluster
panels.description: Which OpenShift minors the installed version of each operator supports, per Red Hat. Compare against this cluster's current minor and its update channel's target (Clusters table above). Untracked operators are not listed.

panels.title: OpenShift minors: current phase
panels.description: Every supported OpenShift minor, plus any minor a cluster is running or targeting.

panels.title: OpenShift minors: phase end dates
panels.description: Published end date of each lifecycle phase. Empty where the phase does not apply (e.g. EUS on odd minors).

panels.title: Lifecycle data age
panels.description: Oldest successful Red Hat API fetch across the selected clusters. Refreshes every 4h.

panels.title: Cluster data age
panels.description: Oldest successful read of ClusterVersion/Subscriptions. Refreshes every 10m.

panels.title: Clusters with stale data
panels.description: Clusters whose exporter has not reached access.redhat.com in 24h.
